text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I bump into Mejiro Ardan and
Yaeno
Muteki in front of the hospital.
They tell me that
they're about to hold a
story time session in the
children's ward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm planning to read the tale of

Momotaro. Yaeno here kindly offered to
lend her
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was so inspired by Ardan's altruism that
I wished
to contribute however possible.
And so, I've been
assigned the role of
Momotaro himself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you for your help. I'm sure
that
acting out the characters' dialogue
together will
help fully immerse the
children in the story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Volunteering to do story time for
children is such
a wonderful idea that I
can't help but want to be
part of it.
Mejiro Ardan assigns me the role of the

dog!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Ardan! We've missed you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've missed all of you too.
I've
brought another book along with me
today,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am. When I was hospitalized before, we
often
played together. Seeing them all
smile made me
feel so much better while
I was recovering.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That must make them dear
friends of
yours, then.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ardan's brought someone new with
her! She
looks strong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, everyone. I'm not sure Yaeno
will
appreciate getting hugged by all of
you at once.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Such tiny and innocent lives! I-I
must keep
them safe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, I must pull myself together! I am
here today
to help ensure that story
time progresses
smoothly and without
delays!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please, children, be still! We will now
begin story
time. Please line up over
here, sit down, and
listen quietly!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, Ardan's friend is so funny!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Do we just hafta sit in a row? Okay! Then
I'm
gonna sit right here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it looks like everyone's
seated. How
clever and well-behaved
you all are.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: Hehe! We're lined up all nice and neat!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what's today's story gonna be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Today, we'll read the story of
Momotaro.
Once upon a time, long, long
ago...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I'll help you slay the demons, but in
return, I
want some of those millet
dumplings you have in
your waist
pouch."

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Millet dumplings"? What are they?
Are
they tasty?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Millet dumplings are like normal
dumplings, but
they're made using
millet. Millet is a grain, just
like rice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In the past, sugar was very precious and hard to come by, so I imagine people made them with mizuame syrup or honey instead. They probably tasted like mildly sweet dango.

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I wonder if they're squishy. I
wanna try
one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Well, in that case, shall we see
if we can
borrow the kitchen and make
some?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's make lots and lots of
dumplings!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's perfectly all right. I don't want to
let the
children's enthusiasm and interest
go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's start making some millet

dumplings. Today we'll be using sticky
millet and
mizuame.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The fire's dangerous, so I'll be in charge
of boiling
the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, you'll be in charge of
kneading the
sticky millet and shaping
them into dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By carefully following Mejiro Ardan's
instructions,
the children whip up a
batch of delicious-looking
dumplings!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Millet dumplings are yummy! They're so
soft and
chewy!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cooking is pretty easy! I wanna
make
dumplings again someday!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Having an interest in something sure
boosts one's
ability to learn about it,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it seems that way. I'd be
delighted if this
experience helped
broaden their interests and
deepen their
understanding of the story.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it was my own
fervent desire
to read martials arts
guidebooks that led me to
learning how
to read classical writing. I suppose
I'm
just like these children.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... So sparking one's interest is key
to
learning... Perhaps history is the
same...
